desc: Ideation: settle on per-vitamin calorie knapsack + binary search on K with inverse minimum-cost functions.
Implement solution: partition foods by vitamin; per-vitamin 0/1 knapsack over capacities 0..X for max units at most c calories; prefix-max to enforce monotonicity.
Compute g_v(K)=min calories to reach >=K via bisect_left on each monotone dp; binary search largest K in [0, min_v dp_v[X]] with sum of g_v(K) <= X; handle K=0 and INF/impossible cases.
Optimize the O(N*X) knapsack loop (local variable binding, cap iteration bounds, optional numpy fast path with pure-Python fallback).
Run both samples and confirm outputs 3 and 0 respectively; test edge cases (single vitamin missing, X too small).
